features: Allows shooting, using Med Kits, and throwing grenades/throwables on zipline

hud_and_combat_qol.sniper_crosshair: Permanent crosshair displayed at screen center without scoping
hud_and_combat_qol.charge_buster_warning: In-game audio/visual alert when an enemy nearby is charging Charge Buster
hud_and_combat_qol.cyber_mushroom: Can now be activated using melee attacks and fists
hud_and_combat_qol.scope_hud: Magnification level indicated under scope HUD
hud_and_combat_qol.backpack_hud: Updated attachment slot icons matching equipped and unequipped states
hud_and_combat_qol.homer_skill_targeting: Prioritizes alive enemies over downed enemies

custom_room_features.quit_out_penalty: Bans players from joining other rooms if quitting early or AFK
custom_room_features.save_custom_preset: Allows saving room rules as presets (excluding name/password)

graphics_performance.performance_mode: Added under Ultra and MAX graphics to boost FPS, minimize heating, and extend battery life
